It reads the PRODUCT's own markup instead of the artboards, and it is additive: the artboard readers are untouched, and the self-tests assert in BOTH directions that the two readers cannot see each other's form (the artboard reader finds nothing in built markup and vice versa), so a surface can never be scored by the wrong extractor.

A predicate that cannot return false is not a predicate.

It does not merely count states: it asserts EXCLUSIVITY - every cell declaring a state carries exactly ONE state mark, so a cell drawn as two states (the collapse) fails the suite - and it requires the fixture to exercise all four. Measured tally on the exported surfaces: template-city count=8 measured-zero=4 cannot-occur=8; bundled unmeasured=12 cannot-occur=8; empty-city unmeasured=12 cannot-occur=8.
acceptanceVerbatim.theFourthStateIsThePoint: The four states are count / measured-zero / unmeasured / cannot-occur. An unresolved pack is asserted to draw unmeasured + cannot-occur and NEVER a counted zero, because that is the comparison the four states exist to stop a reader making.
